race.comment: IRON STUPA (7) showed talent last prep, even if he was a touch weak at times. He looked forward in condition when winning his latest jump-out, and he will be ready to run a big race fresh up. AMARILLO SKY (1) has recently joined the Matt Jenkins yard from the Maher stable, and a quieter environment can help some horses. He has won a recent jump-out and should be respected on an each-way basis. OTTALUS (8) has found some form on the Ballarat-Synthetic, and he can make full use off his good draw here. A return to a turf surface won't bother him, and off a 7-day backup, he will be hard to beat in this. ADIEU GRASSE (15) only weakened late fresh up, and he should be a quick improver in this, so include in all top 4 combos. ILOVEDIAMONDS (14) strips fitter second up, and she won't be far away. Include.
